# pMD

> pMD provides integrated healthcare revenue cycle management, clinical software, and telehealth solutions for medical providers.

pMD offers a comprehensive suite of products including pRevenue for RCM services, pCharge for mobile charge capture, pChat for HIPAA-compliant communications, and pSuite for clinical support. The platform serves healthcare providers with billing automation, practice management, and patient engagement tools.

## Key Topics

- Revenue Cycle Management (RCM)
- Charge Capture
- Medical Billing & Collections
- HIPAA-Compliant Communication
- Healthcare Software
- Billing Automation
- Practice Management
- Telehealth
- pRevenue
- pCharge

- pSuite
- Healthcare Providers
- Mobile Health Apps
- Patient Intake

## Core Products & Solutions

- [End to End Revenue Cycle Management Solutions](https://www.pmd.com/solutions): pMD's end-to-end RCM solutions including pRevenue, pCharge, and pChat.
- [pRevenue - RCM Services, Medical Billing & Collections](https://www.pmd.com/solution/prevenue): pRevenue medical billing and RCM services platform for revenue optimization.
- [pCharge - Mobile Charge Capture App](https://www.pmd.com/solution/pcharge): pCharge mobile app for point-of-care charge capture and billing automation.
- [pChat - HIPAA-Compliant Texting & Video Chat](https://www.pmd.com/solution/pchat): pChat secure messaging and video communication app for healthcare providers.
- [pSuite - Clinical Software Services & Support](https://www.pmd.com/services/psuite): pSuite support and clinical software services with 24/7 technical assistance.
